The Java CMF 2026 engine and its dependencies are included in
app/src/main/java/com/mi/onextbox/color2026.
Changes: package/import relocation to com.mi.onextbox.color2026;
removed compile-time Error Prone Var/CanIgnoreReturnValue annotations.
Color algorithms are unchanged. Only SchemeCmf is included from scheme/.
This namespace is separate from COUI's MaterialKolor 5.x runtime.
